199:
[Partial translation]
In the book of Rav Hamenuna, it explains further: all of the civilization turns about like a ball, some [of the civilization] are above, and some [of the civilization] are below. And all creatures differ from each other because of different climatic conditions, that are in every place, and they are existent just like the other humans are [existent].
200:
[Translation covers passages 58–59]
And the Shelamim sacrifice is completeness, and peace for all. And a person that offers a shelamim spreads peace in the world. Yaakov is the one who makes peace, as we said, since he is the one for this [side] and this [side]. And the shelamim unifies the positive mitzvot and negative mitzvot, from this side and from this side. And because of this it is called shelamim [completeness]. And the secret of the word is that it is written 'And Yaakov was a TAM person' (Genesis 25:27): a complete person. Complete above and complete below. Another explanation [for Job 25:2]: "dominion" this is Michael. "Dread" this is Gavriel. This [angel, Michael] has its basis of water, this [angel, Gavriel] has the basis of fire. And the Holy One of Blessing makes peace between them, as it is written "He makes peace on His heights / among the high ones" (Job 25:2).
201: ... And he didn't ask mercy for the world, and the water came, and all the people died. That's why it's called Noah's waters. Noah's water of course, because it was his fault. For he didn't ask mercy for the world.
203:
[Partial translation]
And if it is found that he is fit, we give him all the stringency of the Temple. But if not, he does not ascend to the service. This is [the meaning] of that which is written: And of Levi he said, "Let Your Thummim and Urim be with Your faithful one"(Deuteronomy 33:8). Why did (Aaron) merit the Urim and Thummim and to perform the service? You must say: Whom You tested, etc. Who said of his father and mother, I consider them not, etc. (Deuteronomy 33:8-9). And once he is found to be on these [proper] levels — then: They shall teach Your laws to Jacob, etc. they shall offer incense, etc., to calm the [divine] anger and to bring peace. And whole-offerings on Your altar (Deuteronomy 33:10). Since all is enriched, and blessing are found in all of the worlds, then: Bless, Lord, his substance, etc. (Deuteronomy 33:11).
